LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_SettingTooltip: Shows two approximate death forecasts: current bleeding control maintained, and no further tending as temporary control wears off. The tooltip explains causes and remaining risks. Calculated only while this pawn's Health tab is open. Disabling restores the vanilla countdown.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_OtherRisks: Other hazards or random complications may cause earlier death.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_CEStabilization: CE stabilization is temporary; bleeding may return. Fully tend the wounds.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_CurrentConditions: Assumes current exposure and care continue, with no further treatment.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_CapacityFailure: Projected cause: loss of {0}. Treat the underlying condition.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_CurrentScenario: Current control: assumes present bleeding reductions are maintained. Other modeled conditions continue to progress.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_UntendedScenario: Without tending: assumes no further treatment. Temporary bleeding control weakens and expires.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_TemporaryControl: Untended wounds remain temporarily controlled. Bleeding can increase again; no forecast beyond its modeled horizon guarantees safety. Fully tend the wounds.
LanguageData.MI_Prognosis_Uncertain: The untreated bleeding baseline could not be determined. The future death estimate is uncertain.
